targetText: This was in 1902, when Kautsky wrote an article for the revolutionary Iskra, [1] entitled “The Slavs and Revolution”.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in In What Sense We Can Speak of the International Significance of the Russian Revolution: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText: How well Karl Kautsky wrote eighteen years ago!
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
